comparison_contract.task: top10 neighbor fidelity after embedding quantization
comparison_contract.measurement_protocol: 100x320 float32 cosine retrieval after storage roundtrip; warmup excluded; 25 serial calls; tracemalloc peak excludes model weights and nontraced native memory
comparison_contract.metric: mean top10 neighbor overlap with float32 reference (higher better)

interpretation: Quality must be higher-is-better. Different contracts are never ranked together. Sample means alone do not establish statistical dominance; repeat runs and quantify uncertainty before claiming a winner.
study_note: Actual local measurements of saved embedding retrieval, not ESM inference cost. Quality is neighbor fidelity, not biological accuracy; memory is traced allocation peak, not GPU/process RSS. Tiny timing gaps are noisy and no statistical winner is claimed.
